name: Slider
description: A value, or a range, along a track. Drawn as Flutter's M3 slider on both platforms.

label.description: The field's name, drawn above it.

isLabelHidden.description: Hides the label from sight; it still names the field for a screen reader.

errorMessage.description: Set means invalid: the field shows this message under it.

defaultValue.description: Starts at this value; the merchant changes it. A pair when isRange.

value.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree. A pair when isRange.

isRange.description: Two thumbs: a price range filter.

formatStyle.description: percent is the fraction of the range.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 code, or IRT for toman, drawn as the amount and «تومان».

name.description: Names the value inside a Form block.

onChangeEnd.description: The value when the thumb is released: save it.
